emails.subject: Pharmacy First at Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic
emails.body: What Pharmacy First is Pharmacy First is an NHS advanced service in England that allows patients to access assessment and treatment for seven common conditions directly from a participating community pharmacy, without needing a GP appointment first. Trained pharmacists use approved Patient Group Directions (PGDs) and clinical assessment tools to decide whether treatment can be supplied in Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic, whether the patient should be referred to a GP, or whether urgent or emergency care is needed. The service covers: acute sore throat (including suspected streptococcal infection), acute otitis media (earache) in children and young people, impetigo, infected insect bites and stings, shingles, acute sinusitis, and uncomplicated urinary tract infection (UTI) in women aged 16–64. Consultations take place in a private consultation room. Call 01226 210477 (Darfield).

emails.subject: Your Pharmacy First appointment at Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic
emails.body: Pharmacy First — From Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic — Before appointment - Patient identifies symptoms matching one of the seven conditions. - Contact participating pharmacy by phone, walk-in, or online booking where available. - Bring NHS number if known, list of current medicines, allergy information, and details of symptom onset. - For UTI pathway: be ready to provide urine sample if pharmacy requests dipstick testing. - For children: parent/carer must attend with child. Call 01226 210477 (Darfield).

emails.subject: What to expect from Pharmacy First at Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic
emails.body: From Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic — Eligibility 1. Do I need to be registered with a GP to use Pharmacy First? 2. Can I use Pharmacy First if I am not English but live in England with an NHS GP? 3. Call 01226 210477 (Darfield).

emails.subject: When to seek other care — Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic
emails.body: From Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic — Myth: Pharmacy First is the same as asking the pharmacist for advice over the counter. Reality: It is a formal NHS clinical service with structured assessment, documentation, and PGD-supply of prescription-only medicines where criteria are met. Myth: Any pharmacy in England must offer Pharmacy First. Reality: Only pharmacies that have signed up and trained staff to deliver the advanced service can provide it. Myth: Pharmacists give antibiotics to everyone with a sore throat. Call 01226 210477 (Darfield).
